en-US.description: Presentations and slide shows: an open-source, clean-room reimplementation of Microsoft PowerPoint in pure Rust
en-US.longDescription:
DeckCraft builds presentations and slide shows: an open-source, clean-room reimplementation of Microsoft PowerPoint, rebuilt in pure Rust. Build decks with themes, layouts, shapes, pictures, tables, charts, transitions and animations, open and save PowerPoint files, and present them full screen. Every button is also a command that the CLI and AI agents, through MCP, can drive.

What works today
- Make decks: slide masters and eleven layouts with placeholders that inherit position and formatting, eight original themes, sections, notes, comments, headers and footers, custom slide sizes.
- Draw: 150+ preset shapes with adjust handles, connectors that stay glued to shapes, freeform, curve and scribble tools, merge shapes, gradient, picture and pattern fills, outlines with dashes and arrowheads, shadows, glow, soft edges and reflections.
- Write: in-place text editing with full font and paragraph formatting, bullets and numbering, columns, autofit, vertical text, fields and hyperlinks.
- Add content: pictures with crop and corrections, tables with styles, charts, SmartArt basics, audio and video.
- Present: transitions including Morph, entrance, emphasis, exit and motion-path animations, by-paragraph builds, full-screen slide show, presenter view, pen and rehearse timings.
- Exchange files: open and save PowerPoint .pptx, export PDF with slides, notes pages and handouts, PNG/JPEG and outlines; AutoRecover keeps unsaved work.
- Automate: 200+ commands with undo, scriptable from the CLI, a JSON control channel and an MCP server for AI agents.

zh-CN.description: 演示文稿和幻灯片：一个用纯 Rust 全新重写的 Microsoft PowerPoint 开源净室实现
zh-CN.longDescription:
DeckCraft 用于制作演示文稿和幻灯片：一个用纯 Rust 全新重写的 Microsoft PowerPoint 开源净室实现。用主题、版式、形状、图片、表格、图表、切换和动画来搭建演示文稿，打开并保存 PowerPoint 文件，全屏放映。每个按钮同时也是一个命令，CLI 和 AI 代理（通过 MCP）都能驱动。

当前可用功能
- 制作演示文稿：幻灯片母版和十一种版式（占位符可继承位置与格式）、八套原创主题、节、备注、批注、页眉和页脚、自定义幻灯片尺寸。
- 绘图：150 多种带调整控制柄的预设形状、吸附到形状的连接符、自由曲线和涂鸦工具、形状合并（联合、组合、拆分、相交、剪除）、渐变/图片/图案填充、带虚线和箭头的轮廓、阴影、发光、柔化边缘和倒影。
- 文字：就地文本编辑，完整的字体和段落格式，项目符号和编号，分栏，自动调整大小，竖排文本，域和超链接。
- 添加内容：可裁剪和校正的图片、带样式的表格、图表、SmartArt 基础功能、音频和视频。
- 放映：切换（含平滑 Morph）、进入/强调/退出和动作路径动画、按段落构建、全屏幻灯片放映、演示者视图、画笔和排练计时。
- 文件交换：打开并保存 PowerPoint .pptx，导出 PDF（幻灯片、备注页、讲义，文本可选）、PNG/JPEG 和大纲；AutoRecover 保存未完成的工作。
- 自动化：200 多个带撤销的命令，可通过 CLI、JSON 控制通道和面向 AI 代理的 MCP 服务器调用。
